numIndexScans.description: Number of index scans initiated on this index.

numTuplesRead.description: Number of index entries returned by scans on this index.

numTuplesFetched.description: Number of live table rows fetched by simple index scans using this index.

numBlksRead.description: Number of disk blocks read from this index.

numBlksHit.description: Number of buffer hits in this index.
